item.title: Choosing an Image Library: OpenCV and Its Peers
item.description: The previous post, Image Basics & Getting Started with OpenCV, treated OpenCV as the default tool for basic operations. But when it comes to picking a library for a real project, OpenCV is not the only player, and not every scenario plays to its strengths. This post walks through the current state of OpenCV itself and its main peers. Version numbers were verified in September 2026; treat this as a tool map for the image-processing posts that follow.
